A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''rescue frigate''' was a vessel meant to rescue passengers from doomed ships.

==Characteristics==
These ships had similar design-features to the vessels of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], and may have been made by the company.

==History==
A rescue [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] carrying [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] rescued the passengers of the ''[[Aurorient Express]]''.
